record.original_question: Let G be a graph with m edges and clique number omega(G). Must the two largest adjacency eigenvalues satisfy lambda_1(G)^2 + lambda_2(G)^2 <= 2(1 - 1/omega(G))m?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3 (Bollobás-Nikiforov [22]). Let G be a graph on m edges. Then λ1^2(G) + λ2^2(G) ≤ 2(1 − 1/ω(G))m.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph with $m$ edges. Let $A(G)$ be its adjacency matrix, and let $\lambda_1(G) \geq \lambda_2(G) \geq \cdots$ denote the eigenvalues of $A(G)$ in non-increasing order. Let $\omega(G)$ denote the clique number of $G$, i.e., the size of the largest complete subgraph of $G$ (with the convention $1 - 1/\omega(G) = 0$ when $G$ has no edges).

Prove or disprove: for every such graph $G$,
$$\lambda_1(G)^2 + \lambda_2(G)^2 \;\leq\; 2\!\left(1 - \frac{1}{\omega(G)}\right) m.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture remains open in general. Partial results are known: it is verified for triangle-free graphs, regular graphs, complete multipartite graphs, graphs with few triangles (e.g., planar, book-free, cycle-free), and dense K₄-free graphs. A 2025 result shows it holds asymptotically almost surely for random graphs, and weaker-constant versions are known for all graphs.

status_evidence.title: Bollobás-Nikiforov conjecture holds asymptotically almost surely
status_evidence.snippet: Shows the conjecture holds with probability tending to 1 for random graphs; states the general conjecture remains open.
status_evidence.claim: General case still open as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: Bollobás-Nikiforov Conjecture for graphs with not so many triangles
status_evidence.snippet: Verifies the conjecture for graphs with O(m^{1.5-ε}) triangles.

status_evidence.title: The Bollobás–Nikiforov Conjecture for Complete Multipartite Graphs and Dense K4-Free Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the conjecture for complete multipartite graphs and dense K4-free graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Special cases solved; full conjecture remains open.
